settings.label: Monogramming Service product
settings.info: The product that carries the personalization fee. Must be Active and published to the Online Store. While this is empty the personalization panel is hidden on every product.

settings.label: Shipping estimate
settings.info: Shown on every product page. A product's own Delivery Time field overrides it. Keep the wording about how long you take to ship, not when it arrives — the arrival date is calculated at checkout from Settings → Shipping and delivery.

settings.label: Shipping estimate, personalized items
settings.default: Personalized items usually ship in 5–7 business days
settings.info: Replaces the line above once a customer ticks Add Personalization. Leave empty to always show the standard estimate.
